criteria.instruction_fidelity: Follows the requested transformation or description.
criteria.subject_preservation: Preserves the intended subject identity and important details.
criteria.outside_region_preservation: Preserves pixels/details outside the requested edit region.
criteria.naturalness: Looks coherent and free of visible artifacts.
criteria.detail_retention: Retains useful detail without introducing upscale artifacts.
criteria.shape_fidelity: Preserves important shapes, proportions, and composition.
criteria.editability: SVG structure remains valid and practically editable.
criteria.style_fidelity: Matches the requested visual style while preserving required content.
criteria.factual_grounding: Caption claims are supported by visible image content.
criteria.hallucination_control: Does not invent unsupported objects, text, or attributes.
criteria.text_accuracy: Recognized text matches the source image.
criteria.reading_order: Text is grouped and ordered consistently with the image.
criteria.context_preservation: Newly generated content blends with the preserved scene.
criteria.technical_output: Output dimensions, format, alpha, and structure meet the task contract.
